name: Open Interest Flush Reversal
thesis: A sharp collapse in open interest alongside a violent price drop is a liquidation cascade, not a change in valuation. Forced sellers are price-insensitive and finite, so the level they exhaust themselves at tends to hold.
invalidation: Retire if worst-symbol out-of-sample profit factor stays below 1.0 over 30 trades, or if the mechanism's driving series stops being published.
entry_long: oi_ret(32) < -0.03 and ret(32) < -0.02 and close > low + 0.5 * (high - low)
